messages:
Ava: Quick poll — who’s up for an impromptu office disco at 4pm? tiny bluetooth speaker, zero choreography required
Marcus: I will bring my suspiciously energetic playlist. bonus if someone brings glitter. :disco_ball:
Priya: I can bring snacks. not glitter. unless it's edible glitter. :eyes:
Jamal: Can we bribewire this with cookies? I have 8 cookies and bad intentions. :cookie:
Zoe: Vote: cookies > glitter. always. :cookie::heart:
Nadia: PlantBot, will the ficus tolerate house music or will it stage a silent protest?
PlantBot: Ficus prefers low BPM. emits mild passive-aggressive rustle at >90bpm. :seedling:
Ava: ok compromise — 70bpm set, cookie bribe, and one light disco strobie (i promise it's a lava lamp)
Marcus: also quick one-liner challenge while we snack? one sentence, maximum chaos. winner gets a sticker.
Priya: "My laptop's other life is a very quiet accordion"
Jamal: "Coffee: the office's unofficial fuel and occasional escape rope."
Zoe: "Desk plant is judging my code but loves my snacks." :laughing:
Nadia: love these. in person clap emoji. :clap: :clap:
Ava: ok that's settled. 4pm in the kitchenette. bring cookies, not glitter. one-liners encouraged but not mandatory. see y'all there! :party_popper:
